sourceInventory.description: One black-on-white instructional graph, not a portrait. The horizontal axis is labelled B_0 at image right; the vertical axis is labelled I above its upward arrow. A small o marks the shared origin. There are no numbered ticks, numeric data values, grid rows, grid columns, or separate panels.

An S-shaped initial magnetization branch runs from the origin towards positive saturation and carries an upward/rightward direction arrow. A closed hysteresis loop has distinct upper and lower branches: positive saturation a at the upper right, negative saturation a-prime at the lower left, remanence b and b-prime at the positive and negative vertical-axis crossings, and c and c-prime at the negative and positive horizontal-axis crossings. Direction arrows are visible on the upper branch towards the left, the left descending branch downwards, the lower branch towards the right, and the right ascending branch upwards. These positions and arrows carry instructional meaning; no exact coordinates or values were inferred.
The source contains no person, face, hair, clothing, bust, portrait caption, or likeness reference. It cannot establish the facial appearance of A. G. Stoletov.
